description: Add an ungrouped ('full') processing path for MOSAICO Telecom/SMP so the run saves estacoes_full.parquet (Log inline) alongside the unchanged grouped estacoes.parquet + log.parquet.
decisions: D1: Grouped outputs (telecom.parquet, smp.parquet, estacoes.parquet, log.parquet) must remain content-identical to the pre-change code. This is enforced by a baseline snapshot (FULL-01) and a comparison harness (FULL-02).

D2: 'Full' = skip only the row-collapsing groupby in Mosaico.aggregate. Every other step stays: rename, split_designacao (explode), Estação int cast + sort, Largura numeric cast, SMP channel validation (the groupby in Smp.validate_channels is a lookup de-dup over channel intervals, NOT row aggregation — keep it), uplink generation, coordinate handling, merge_on_frequency with aero, Geography.validate, _simplify_sources, _remove_invalid_frequencies, '-1' sentinel fill.

D3: Omit Multiplicidade from the consolidated and per-source full output dataframes and files; it may temporarily be set to 1 internally where existing processing requires it. Grouped outputs retain their existing Multiplicidade. Full mode writes no '#Estação' grouping log entry.

D4: Grouped mode silently drops rows having NA in any agg column (dropna(subset=agg_cols)). Full mode KEEPS those rows (it is the full data). Downstream SMP steps may still drop them (e.g. NA Frequência never matches a Downlink channel) — that is acceptable; do not add new logging for it. If the user later wants parity, it is a one-line dropna in Mosaico.ungrouped.

D5: Full-mode files: telecom_full.parquet, smp_full.parquet, telecom_full_discarded.parquet, smp_full_discarded.parquet, estacoes_full.parquet. Raw caches are shared: full sources read telecom_raw / smp_raw (never *_full_raw).

D6: estacoes_full.parquet has the grouped column set (COLS_SRD) except Multiplicidade, and dtypes 'category' like estacoes.parquet, except 'Log' which holds the merge_dicts JSON string per row (not an integer id). Full mode must NEVER write/overwrite log.parquet.
D7: Estacoes(full=False) is the default (library behaviour unchanged). scripts/main.py get_db exposes --full and defaults it to True so the production run produces both outputs.

D8: The full run reuses the already-formatted SRD, Stel, Radcom and Aero dataframes from the grouped run (they never group), passed as independent copies; only Telecom and Smp are re-formatted in full mode from their raw cache.

userStories.title: Create offline regression harness and baseline snapshot of current grouped outputs
userStories.description: Before touching pipeline code, freeze the current grouped behaviour. Create scripts/full_pipeline_check.py (typer CLI) with a `baseline` command that, fully offline from the caches in extracao/datasources/arquivos/saida/: (1) runs Telecom(read_cache=True).update() and Smp(read_cache=True).update() (these read *_raw.parquet via Mosaico._extract), (2) runs SRD/Stel/Radcom with read_cache=True .update(), (3) loads Aero from aero.parquet via Aero().df (Aero.extraction ignores read_cache and hits the network — never call Aero.update()), (4) builds an Estacoes(read_cache=True) instance, injects those dfs in the same order as Estacoes.init_data_sources ([telecom, smp, srd, stel, radcom, aero]) and calls its _format with an fastcore L of the dfs, with Estacoes.folder pointing at the output dir so log.parquet lands there. Write telecom.parquet, smp.parquet, estacoes.parquet, log.parquet into a gitignored dir passed as --out (default extracao/datasources/arquivos/baseline/). Add a `--sample N` option that truncates telecom_raw/smp_raw to the first N rows (patch the source's _read or pre-slice) for fast iterations; a sampled baseline goes to <out>/sample_<N>/. Add the baseline dir to .gitignore if not already covered (*.parquet already is, but ignore the dir explicitly).

userStories.title: Estacoes full run: build df_full from full Telecom/Smp + reused other sources
userStories.description: Add keyword `full: bool = False` (last param) to Estacoes.__init__. Add method `update_full(self)` that: (1) creates Telecom(self.mongo_uri, self.limit, read_cache=True, full=True) and Smp(..., full=True) with the same folder as the grouped sources — raw caches were just written by the grouped update (or exist when read_cache) — and runs update()+save() on each (parallel like extraction when self.parallel, using Estacoes._update_source); when read_cache and not reprocess_sources, just read their .df (telecom_full.parquet/smp_full.parquet) instead; (2) takes SRD/Stel/Radcom/Aero dfs from self.sources (index 2..5) as `.copy()` (D8); (3) df = self._consolidate(L([telecom_full, smp_full, srd, stel, radcom, aero])); (4) df = self.inline_log(df); (5) self.df_full selects self.columns except Multiplicidade. Other sources may reintroduce Multiplicidade during concat, so exclude it from the final full dataframe regardless. update() calls update_full() after the grouped path when self.full. Order matters: grouped self.df must be computed before update_full, and update_full must not alter self.df or the dfs inside self.sources (mutation via register_log!).

userStories.title: Full-cache end-to-end run, measure, and fix scaling blockers without changing grouped output
userStories.description: Run `full_pipeline_check.py full` on the full cache (no --sample). Only optimize if the full run does not complete in a reasonable time (> ~2h) or OOMs; any optimization must keep `compare` (full cache) green.
